summary: DOCSIS 3.1 added a queue protection algorithm. A shared low-latency queue only works if every flow in it avoids building a queue, but some flows may not, by accident or on purpose. This Informational document explains the algorithm, which deals with flows that threaten to push the queue's delay past a threshold.

eli5.summary: The fast lane only works if everyone in it moves quickly. If someone starts to jam it up, they get moved to the slow lane.

questions: how to stop flows abusing a low-latency queue
